name: dsh-anagenesis
description: 给 Agent 一套它自己管得住、你也看得见的记忆：20 个语义工具、7 种意图召回、可切换策略栈、项目隔离、预设即权限、事件溯源与可回滚、离线检索基准；零运行时依赖、离线、单文件 JSONL，并自带设施仪表盘与终端可视化。

network: registry.npmjs.org (HTTPS GET only, and only when the core row sets updateCheck = npm — the shipped bundle does; set it to `off` for a fully offline install). It reads https://registry.npmjs.org/dsh-anagenesis/latest, compares that version with its own package.json version and shows the result in the window/dashboard. It sends no identifiers (no instance id, no project fingerprint, no memory content), downloads nothing, installs nothing and changes no file. Every failure is shown as a state ("check failed: ...") and never blocks anything else.

permissions.filesystem: dsh-anagenesis owns $DSH_HOME/anagenesis/ (journal/*.jsonl append-only log + snapshot.json). For read compatibility with the pre-rename layout it will ALSO open $DSH_HOME/evolution/ when the new directory does not exist yet, and it never moves that data on its own — `tools/migrate-store.mjs` does the copy and only when the operator runs it. It reads and writes nothing else; it never opens another plugin's memory store. The visualization row only reads that store, and `tools/viz-watch.mjs` is a standalone read-only viewer the operator runs themselves — the plugin never spawns a process. The `anagenesis` preset row may also write $DSH_HOME/.agent-presets/anagenesis/ on hosts that still discover presets as directories, and removes exactly the files it created when unloaded.
permissions.subprocess: none — no shell, no network, no model calls

disclosure.retention: local-only journal under $DSH_HOME/anagenesis; memory deletion is explicit via ana_forget/ana_expire and is itself journaled. Compaction appends archive segments and by default keeps every seq revertible; the optional retainEvents policy (default 0 = off) may prune whole archive segments, and any such loss is recorded in journal/pruned.json and reported by ana_audit view=status
